findings.title: Unspecified scope for site establishment
findings.message: The short and long text only state "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" without defining the required facilities, duration of provision or performance criteria, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 which demands clear and exhaustive descriptions.
findings.suggestion: Specify all required site facilities (e.g., offices, storage, sanitation), their quantities, and the period of provision.

findings.title: Missing technical specifications for frost protection layer
findings.message: The description lacks material type, thickness, thermal conductivity and installation method, which are mandatory according to STLB‑Bau standard texts for frost protection layers.
findings.suggestion: Add material grade (e.g., granular fill), required thickness (e.g., 30 cm), and thermal conductivity value.

findings.title: Insufficient data for PE‑HD pipe delivery
findings.message: Only pipe diameter and material are given; missing pressure class, SDR, standard reference (DIN 8077) and required accessories, which are required for a complete specification.
findings.suggestion: Include pressure rating (e.g., PN 16), SDR value, and list of fittings.

findings.title: Unclear installation requirements for pipe laying
findings.message: The text does not define trench dimensions, bedding material, backfill specifications or testing requirements, which are essential for a VOB‑compliant pipe‑laying description.
findings.suggestion: Add trench width/depth, bedding layer, compaction criteria, and pressure test procedure.

findings.title: Unit mismatch for concrete placement
findings.message: Concrete work is quantified in m² while the actual performance is measured in volume (m³). This contradicts VOB/B § 2 Abs. 6 and leads to calculation errors.
findings.suggestion: Change unit to m³ and adjust quantity accordingly.

findings.title: Missing thermal‑insulation parameters
findings.message: The specification does not state insulation thickness, material type, or thermal conductivity, which are required by the STLB‑Bau standard for floor insulation.
findings.suggestion: Add material (e.g., XPS), thickness (e.g., 100 mm), and λ‑value.

findings.title: Lacking water‑impact class for below‑ground waterproofing
findings.message: The text omits the required Wassereinwirkungsklasse and the specific waterproofing system, contrary to VOB/C DIN 18533 requirements.
findings.suggestion: Specify the waterproofing membrane type and the applicable water‑impact class (e.g., W1.2‑E).

findings.title: Unplausibly low unit price for asphalt deck layer
findings.message: The unit price of €0.10 per tonne is far below market rates and contradicts the earlier price for the asphalt base layer, indicating a likely pricing error.
findings.suggestion: Re‑evaluate the unit price based on current asphalt market rates.

findings.title: Potential duplicate position for site establishment
findings.message: Position 2.1.4.50 repeats the content of 2.1.1.10, which may lead to double payment or contractual ambiguity.
findings.suggestion: Clarify whether the second entry is intended for a separate phase or remove the duplicate.

findings.title: Contractual clause shifting all ground risk to the contractor
findings.message: The preliminary note states "Das gesamte Baugrundrisiko trägt der AN", which may be ineffective under § 307 BGB as an unfair risk allocation.
findings.suggestion: Allocate ground risk according to VOB/A risk‑sharing principles or include a balanced risk‑allocation clause.
